propositions: The dc_store_copy_repo fixture fails on 'git fetch origin tickets' with exit 128 but discards git's stderr via subprocess.run(capture_output=True, check=True), making the root cause undiagnosable.
The fetch is an un-retried network call on the critical path of a 41-minute live job, so any transient network blip causes an ERROR that terminates the test cell.
The git archive and git ls-tree calls in the same fixture use the identical capture+check pattern and likewise lose diagnostic stderr output.
A module-level run_git() helper must replace capture_output+check with explicit check that raises RuntimeError carrying the command, exit status, and git's verbatim stderr.
The fetch-only must have bounded retry logic (FETCH_ATTEMPTS=3) with injectable backoff sleep, failing hard on final attempt rather than silently skipping coverage.
